title: Potassium chloride suicide plan

tellings.quote: And I bought potassium chloride, one of the three chemicals in the lethal injection.

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British computer hacker who says he broke into NASA systems and found signs of a secret space program, describes a dark time in the UK around 2008. He says he bought potassium chloride, one of the chemicals used in lethal injections, planning to end his life. He tells it to show how heavy the consequences of his hacking were for him.
